original:
Use case: ads-marketing / compositing.
Create a finished, exceptionally polished vertical Korean fantasy game season announcement poster, 2:3 portrait, ideally 2048x3072 or higher. This is a real game called 숲켓몬. It must look like an expensive esports season launch key visual designed by a senior Korean game art director, with immaculate Korean typography and hierarchy.
Input 1 is the game's ACTUAL champions trophy. Preserve this exact silver-and-gold silhouette, sculpted handles, blue faceted crystal, and black base as the main visual; do not invent a different trophy. Input 2 is the actual clan command room environment, supporting atmosphere only. Integrate the trophy in an epic blue-black command hall with elegant golden shafts of light, tasteful restrained sparks, sculpted smoke and deep cinematic perspective. Refined metallic gold, icy sapphire and ink black. Strong central composition. The trophy is an aspirational visual, not a promised participation reward. No human characters, no new equipment, no card portraits.
Design a dramatic oversized SEASON 3 title and powerful Korean title, trophy hero in the upper-middle, and an exceptionally legible lower schedule section. Typography is a major part of the artwork: professional bold Korean display sans, elegant editorial layout, generous spacing, high contrast ivory on navy, narrow gold rules, numerals large. Avoid a dashboard full of boxed cards. Avoid ornate clutter behind the text. Use a clear staged timeline and a separate bold recurring schedule strip. All text must be clean, perfectly spelled, and completely contained within generous margins.
EXACT TEXT, render verbatim, no invented words:
Top brand: "숲켓몬"
Main title: "클랜전"
Huge season title: "SEASON 3"
Subheading: "새로운 시즌, 새로운 클랜."
Timeline item 1:
"01  참가 모집"
"9월 28일 (월) 챔피언스리그 종료 즉시"
"시즌 3 참가 신청 시작"
Timeline item 2:
"02  클랜 드래프트"
"9월 29일 (화) 21:00"
"신청 마감과 동시에 자동 시작"
Recurring regular clan war section, very clear:
"정규 클랜전"
"매주 화 · 목 · 토 · 일"
"21:00 — 22:00"
"기존 클랜전 요일과 시간 그대로"
Small but readable footer:
"모든 시간은 한국 시간(KST) 기준"
"챔스 종료일이 변경되면 드래프트는 실제 종료 다음 날 21시에 진행됩니다."
The key message is immediate signup on completion of the current championship and drafting at 21:00 the following calendar day; regular battles remain Tuesday Thursday Saturday Sunday at 21:00 to 22:00. Do not imply recruiting starts at 21:00 on Sept 28. Do not imply the championship or regular battles happen at draft time. No new rewards, no statistics, no price, no registration QR code, no extra logo, no watermark. This is a finished poster ready to share, not a web page mockup, not a photographed poster.
